title: Monotonicity of randomized time
statement: Let $T_1,T_2:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $T_1(n)\le T_2(n)$ for every $n$. Then every language decidable by a bounded-error randomized Turing machine in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T_1$ belongs to the corresponding class with time bounded by a constant multiple of $T_2$.
